accepted.s:
Which of the following States are cited for digitised, single-window clearances under BRAP in the Economic Survey 2025-26?
1. Andhra Pradesh
2. Kerala
3. Tamil Nadu
4. Odisha
Select the correct answer using the code below.
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh, Kerala and Tamil Nadu are cited for digitised, single-window clearances. Odisha is not included in the stated group.
accepted.tq: Identify the exact membership of a named group and reject the nearby added State.

accepted.s:
BRAP 2024 covered which of the following areas?
1. Digital registration
2. Labour compliance
3. Construction permits
Select the correct answer using the code below.
accepted.x: BRAP 2024 covered digital registration, labour compliance and construction permits.
accepted.tq: When all listed policy components are supported, select the complete combination.

accepted.s: Preparation for which BRAP edition had begun as indicated in the India Year Book 2026?
accepted.x: Preparation for BRAP 2026 had begun.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the edition under preparation from the edition already implemented.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding national investment facilitation systems:
1. The FIF portal has been integrated with the National Single Window System since August 2022.
2. The new FDI SOP issued in May 2026 increased the approval period from 10 weeks to 12 weeks.
3. Presumed consent under the new FDI SOP arises after eight weeks.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: FIF integration began in August 2022, the period became 12 weeks from 10 weeks, and presumed consent applies after eight weeks.
accepted.tq: Check dates and altered time limits separately before choosing the coded combination.

accepted.s: Which institution, together with the Industries Department, conducts investor outreach in Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: APEDB and the Industries Department conduct investor outreach under the stated CDI arrangement.
accepted.tq: Match the investor-facilitation function with the responsible institution.
accepted.sec: Investor facilitation - APEDB, DICs, grievance tracking

accepted.s: Which organisation coordinates Single Desk clearances in Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: APIIC coordinates Single Desk clearances in Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Use the institutional-ownership trap by distinguishing APIIC from APEDB and financial bodies.
accepted.sec: Investor facilitation - APEDB, DICs, grievance tracking

accepted.s: Large projects in Andhra Pradesh are tracked through which facility?
accepted.x: Large projects are tracked on the Investment Tracker.
accepted.tq: Identify the exact official name of the tracking mechanism.
accepted.sec: Investor facilitation - APEDB, DICs, grievance tracking

accepted.s: Under IDP 4.0, which description correctly states the SGST reimbursement available to eligible industrial units?
o: 100% of customs duty for five years on imported machinery
100% of net SGST for five years from commercial production on final products made, sold and registered in Andhra Pradesh
50% of gross SGST for three years on all inputs purchased in India
25% of net SGST for ten years from the date of land allotment
accepted.x: IDP 4.0 provides 100% reimbursement of net SGST for five years from commercial production on final products made, sold and registered in Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Read the complete incentive condition, including base, duration, starting point and eligible products.
accepted.sec: Tax incentives - SGST reimbursement, stamp and transfer duty

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding stamp and transfer duty under IDP 4.0:
1. Reimbursement covers land purchase, lease of land, sheds or buildings.
2. Mortgages and hypothecations are covered.
3. The duty is paid once only on a given plot of land.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The reimbursement covers the listed transactions and is paid only once for a given plot.
accepted.tq: Test coverage and the one-time limitation separately within the same incentive.
accepted.sec: Tax incentives - SGST reimbursement, stamp and transfer duty

accepted.s: Under the Andhra Pradesh Industrial Development Policy 2020-23, SGST reimbursement for medium, large and mega units was linked to which condition?
accepted.x: For medium, large and mega units, SGST reimbursement was tied to employment creation for five years.
accepted.tq: Link the incentive to its qualifying performance condition rather than its duration.
accepted.sec: Tax incentives - SGST reimbursement, stamp and transfer duty

accepted.s: What percentage of plots in APIIC parks was reserved for SC entrepreneurs under IDP 2020-23?
accepted.x: IDP 2020-23 reserved 16.2% of plots in APIIC parks for SC entrepreneurs.
accepted.tq: Use the exact percentage and reject rounded figures.
accepted.sec: Land incentives - APIIC plots for SC/ST, concessional allotment, conversion charges

accepted.s: Under IDP 4.0, what proportion of the land-conversion fee is reimbursed?
accepted.x: IDP 4.0 provides 100% reimbursement of the land-conversion fee.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the current policy figure from the older concessional figure.
accepted.sec: Land incentives - APIIC plots for SC/ST, concessional allotment, conversion charges

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the APIIC parks land-cost concession?
o: A 25% rebate up to ₹20 lakh per enterprise
A 50% rebate without any monetary ceiling
A 10% rebate up to ₹10 lakh per enterprise
A 20% rebate up to ₹15 lakh per enterprise
accepted.x: APIIC parks provide a 25% rebate on land cost, subject to a ceiling of ₹20 lakh per enterprise.
accepted.tq: Combine the percentage rebate with its monetary ceiling.
accepted.sec: Land incentives - APIIC plots for SC/ST, concessional allotment, conversion charges

accepted.s: Under the power incentive described for Andhra Pradesh industrial units, fixed power cost is reimbursed at what rate and for what period?
o: ₹3 per unit for five years from registration
₹0.50 per unit for one year from allotment
₹1 per unit for two years from DCP
₹2 per unit for three years from commercial production
accepted.x: Fixed power cost is reimbursed at ₹1 per unit for two years from the date of commencement of production (DCP).
accepted.tq: Pair the unit rate with the exact starting point and duration.
accepted.sec: Power incentives - power cost reimbursement, electricity duty

accepted.s: Pavala vaddi enables a unit to pay interest effectively at which rate per ₹100 per month?
accepted.x: Under pavala vaddi, the State reimburses interest above 3% a year, so the unit effectively pays a quarter rupee, or 25 paise, per ₹100 per month.
accepted.tq: Convert the named fraction into its numerical amount.
accepted.sec: Interest subsidy - pavala vaddi, MSME interest subvention

accepted.s:
Which of the following correctly describes the interest-related support available under the stated schemes?
1. APSEZ units receive a 3% interest subsidy on term loans.
2. MSME Policy 4.0 offers collateral-free loans.
3. MSME Policy 4.0 provides interest subventions.
Select the correct answer using the code below.
accepted.x: APSEZ units receive a 3% subsidy on term loans, while MSME Policy 4.0 offers collateral-free loans and interest subventions.
accepted.tq: Separate the beneficiary-specific incentive from the broader MSME policy measures.
accepted.sec: Interest subsidy - pavala vaddi, MSME interest subvention

accepted.s: What mechanism was added in IDP 4.0 to ensure timely payment of promised subsidies?
accepted.x: IDP 4.0 introduced an Escrow Guarantee mechanism for timely payment of promised subsidies.
accepted.tq: Identify the exact institutional mechanism rather than a similarly named financial facility.
accepted.sec: Incentive arrears - pending dues and clearing

accepted.s: In July 2022, APIIC signed a memorandum of understanding with which institution to provide loans to MSMEs in 39 industrial parks?
accepted.x: APIIC signed the July 2022 MoU with Union Bank of India for loans to MSMEs in 39 industrial parks.
accepted.tq: Match the date, partner institution and beneficiary coverage in one combination.
accepted.sec: MSME credit tie-ups - MoUs with financial institutions

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly represents the cooperative credit chain that reaches rural MSMEs in Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: The stated cooperative credit chain consists of 2,042 PACS, 13 DCCBs and APCOB, and it also reaches rural MSMEs.
accepted.tq: Check both the numerical composition and the apex institution.
accepted.sec: MSME credit tie-ups - MoUs with financial institutions

accepted.s: Under the MSE-CDP of the Government of India, which organisation serves as the State Implementing Agency in Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: APIIC is the State Implementing Agency for the MSE Cluster Development Programme in Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Use the implementation-agency trap among closely related industrial institutions.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding MSE-CDP projects in Andhra Pradesh:
1. Twenty-nine projects were approved.
2. Eleven projects were completed.
3. Eighteen projects were at advanced stages.
4. Twenty-eight new proposals and three new industrial parks were included.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The programme had 29 approved projects, of which 11 were completed and 18 were at advanced stages; it also recorded 28 new proposals and three new industrial parks.
accepted.tq: Retain the complete numerical profile instead of selecting only the headline total.

accepted.s: The Andhra Pradesh Cluster Development Programme (AP CDP) was notified through which Government Order and on what date?
accepted.x: AP CDP was notified through G.O. Ms. No. 17 dated 10 January 2026.
accepted.tq: Combine the order number with the exact date to avoid near-match distractors.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the approved AP Cluster Development Programme for 2026-30?
o: Outlay of ₹250 crore, 50 clusters and funding up to 75% of project cost
Outlay of ₹100 crore, 25 clusters and funding up to 50% of project cost
Outlay of ₹200 crore, 45 clusters with Common Facility Centres and funding up to 80% of project cost
Outlay of ₹200 crore, 30 clusters without Common Facility Centres and full funding of project cost
accepted.x: The AP CDP has an outlay of ₹200 crore, covers 45 clusters with Common Facility Centres and can fund up to 80% of project cost.
accepted.tq: Compare the programme's outlay, cluster count, facility component and funding ceiling together.

accepted.s: The revised AP CDP projections for 2026-30 indicate benefits for how many units and creation of how many jobs?
accepted.x: The revised projections are 1,688 units benefiting and 7,032 jobs being created. The earlier January 2026 announcement had mentioned 1,840 units and 7,500 jobs.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between revised figures and the earlier announcement.

accepted.s: The AP Cluster Development Programme is to operate across which three regions?
accepted.x: The three regions are Visakhapatnam, Amaravati and Tirupati.
accepted.tq: Use the exact regional grouping rather than substituting other major Andhra Pradesh cities.

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II:
List-I (Craft cluster)
 a. Etikoppaka lacquer toys
 b. Kondapalli toys
 c. Mangalagiri handloom

List-II (District)
 i. Guntur
 ii. NTR
 iii. Anakapalli

Select the correct answer using the code below.
accepted.x: Etikoppaka lacquer toys are associated with Anakapalli, Kondapalli toys with NTR, and Mangalagiri handloom with Guntur.
accepted.tq: Start with the sure craft-district pair and eliminate codes that break the remaining one-to-one matches.

accepted.s: Etikoppaka lacquer toys are particularly associated with which combination?
o: Kondapalli toys, teak wood and synthetic colours
Mangalagiri handloom, cotton yarn and block printing
GI status, bamboo wood and chemical dyes
GI status, Ankudu wood and natural dyes
accepted.x: Etikoppaka lacquer toys have GI status and are made using Ankudu wood and natural dyes.
accepted.tq: Test the distinctive material and GI descriptors of a craft cluster.

accepted.s: APMSMEDC, headquartered at Mangalagiri, implements which programme?
accepted.x: APMSMEDC, whose office is at Mangalagiri, implements the RAMP programme.
accepted.tq: Match the institution and location with its specific programme responsibility.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding RAMP:
1. It is a World Bank-backed central sector scheme.
2. It was launched in 2022.
3. Its stated period is 2022-23 to 2026-27.
4. States prepare Strategic Investment Plans under it.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: RAMP is a World Bank-backed central sector scheme launched in 2022 for 2022-23 to 2026-27, with State Strategic Investment Plans.
accepted.tq: Verify the funding partner, launch year, duration and state-level planning feature independently.

accepted.s: Which organisation conducted a review of RAMP in April 2026?
accepted.x: A World Bank team reviewed RAMP in April 2026.
accepted.tq: Apply the organisation-scheme association without replacing the stated international partner.

accepted.s: The RAMP buyer-seller meet held from 19 to 21 August 2026 was run by APMSMEDC in association with which organisation?
accepted.x: APMSMEDC conducted the buyer-seller meet in association with FIEO.
accepted.tq: Match the event organiser with its collaborating organisation.

accepted.s: Which set of figures correctly describes the RAMP buyer-seller meet of August 2026?
o: 40+ buyers from 20 countries, 200 MSMEs and 88 MoUs
25+ buyers from 40 countries, 188 MSMEs and 80 MoUs
40+ buyers from 25 countries, 250+ MSMEs and 88 MoUs
50+ buyers from 25 countries, 250+ MSMEs and 68 MoUs
accepted.x: The event brought together more than 40 buyers from 25 countries, over 250 MSMEs and resulted in 88 MoUs.
accepted.tq: Retain the three-part event profile and reject options with one altered figure.

accepted.s: The NSIC Venture Capital Fund implements the SRI Fund, whose total size and GoI contribution are respectively:
accepted.x: The SRI Fund is ₹50,000 crore, consisting of ₹10,000 crore from the Government of India and ₹40,000 crore leveraged.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the total fund size from the government contribution and leveraged amount.

accepted.s: Which institution implements the MSMED Act at the district level in Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: District Industries Centres implement the MSMED Act at the district level.
accepted.tq: Identify the level-specific implementing authority.
